summary: I analysed all 149 C test sources (147 .c, content_scale_test_input.h, routing_patchbay_ui_test.inc) together with their CMake registrations and the argv/env/file contract the Python runners provide. Classification: A=99 compile and run unchanged once the global CMake/CTest changes are in; B=36 need small edits; C=11 need part of the test rewritten; D=3 are Linux-only. 96 files need a display and 50 need owned virtual audio outputs. I checked the risky Windows behaviour with small probe programs built in the scratchpad against MSYS2 GLib 2.90 and GTK 3.24.52. Results: g_file_test(IS_SYMLINK) is always FALSE and g_lstat reports links as regular files, so the 15 private remove_tree helpers would follow directory links and delete their targets. g_stat gives st_ino 0 and fake 0666 permission bits, and `struct stat` passed to g_stat is a compile error. g_file_set_contents and g_unlink fail while another process holds the file open. g_time_zone_new_identifier returns NULL for IANA zones such as Europe/Istanbul. --wrap has no effect on GLib functions (they are dllimport), while gtk_* and radios_* wraps work. On PE, --gc-sections still reports undefined references. Custom GDK selection atoms print a warning that G_DEBUG=fatal-warnings makes fatal, and CLIPBOARD writes the real system clipboard; PRIMARY stays in-process. g_usleep(1000) sleeps 15.5 ms unless timeBeginPeriod(1) is called. GDK_BACKEND=x11 makes GTK init fail, and windows larger than the monitor are clamped. Recommended design: 13 shared bases (test_playout_ui.c is included by 22 tests) are fixed once, and a new tests/radios_test_support.h/.c handles the B edits: no-follow tree removal, symlink with junction fallback, owner-only ACL check, FileId, pread/pwrite, sparse files, retrying replace/unlink, path equality, long temp paths, IANA tz, numeric locale, PRIMARY-based selection data. GUI tests run on a private CreateDesktop desktop instead of Xvfb. XTest is replaced by posted WM_MOUSE*/WM_KEY* messages, which the probe showed produce real GTK clicks, focus and Ctrl-modified text; SendInput is a serialized fallback for the interactive desktop. Audio tests rely on a virtual WASAPI backend mode supplied by the audio area: env-named sinks that write continuous float32 capture files (replacing parec), <sink>.monitor sources, and a control API for server loss and hotplug. The D tests get Windows twins: a fake-IMMDeviceEnumerator hotplug test, a fake-WinMM MIDI test using macro renaming, and a WASAPI recovery test.
files_touched: CMakeLists.txt (WIN32 guards for pulse/alsa/xtst, GDK_BACKEND=x11 removal, /tmp working dirs, manifest+runtime TU for every test target, RESOURCE_LOCKs, desktop wrapper)

cmake/Prompt5Tests.cmake, cmake/Prompt7Tests.cmake, cmake/Prompt8Tests.cmake, cmake/Pdf4Neon.cmake, cmake/MediaArchive.cmake, cmake/ResetUi.cmake, cmake/LibraryAnalysis.cmake, cmake/SilenceGuard.cmake (GDK_BACKEND env)
key_decisions: Port the 13 shared bases first (test_playout_ui.c with 22 includers, routing_patchbay_ui_test.inc, content_scale_test_input.h, test_audio_ui.c, test_automation_calendar.c, test_playout.c, test_dj_ui.c, test_broadcast_ui.c, test_programme_queue.c, test_playlist_redesign_ui.c, test_automation_calendar_plan.c, test_player_workspace_ui.c, autoplay_execution_clock.c); the 38 includers then need no edits.

Introduce tests/radios_test_support.h/.c (rt_* API, spec section 5). POSIX branches keep today's semantics; Windows branches call platform.h. Every B edit becomes a mechanical replacement: rt_remove_tree (never follows links), rt_symlink with junction fallback and skip, rt_is_link, rt_assert_private_file (owner-only DACL), rt_make_world_readable, rt_file_id (FileId instead of st_ino), rt_open/rt_pread/rt_pwrite, rt_create_sized_file (sparse), rt_set_contents/rt_unlink (retry on sharing violations), rt_path_equal, rt_make_tmp_dir (long final path), rt_time_zone, rt_numeric_locale_push/pop, rt_selection_data_new (PRIMARY on Windows).

Link a constructor TU and the UTF-8 application manifest into every test executable so the 149 main() functions stay untouched (UTF-8 argv, timeBeginPeriod(1), no WER or abort dialogs, binary _fmode).

Replace Xvfb with a private desktop launcher (CreateDesktopW + CreateProcessW with lpDesktop). Replace XTest with rt_input_* that posts WM_MOUSEMOVE/BUTTON/WHEEL/KEY messages to the GDK HWND under the screen point and uses SetKeyboardState for modifiers (verified by probe). SendInput is an opt-in fallback for real OLE drag-and-drop, serialized with a RESOURCE_LOCK.

Keep the runner/C env contract unchanged (RADIOS_TEST_{MAIN,CUE,MONITOR}_SINK/_CAPTURE, RADIOS_TEST_MIC_SOURCE, OUTPUT_*, gate files, argv[1]=root, exit code 77). The audio area provides a virtual WASAPI backend that honours it; the C tests do not change.

D tests are excluded on WIN32 and replaced by twins with identical assertions: test_wasapi_hotplug.c (fake IMMDeviceEnumerator through an internal enumerator seam), test_midi_hotplug_win32.c (fake WinMM via #define renames around the included backend TU), and test_wasapi_recovery.c (virtual backend control API: server stop/restart/missing sink, sink add/remove, flush gap measured from the capture file).

Never add -Wl,--wrap for GLib/GIO/json-glib/cairo/WinAPI symbols, because they are dllimport. test_header_ui instead uses a wrapper TU that macro-renames g_get_real_time, following the autoplay_execution_clock.c pattern.

Fork-based tests (test_recovery) use g_test_trap_subprocess_with_envp; flock becomes radios_platform_lock_fd (LockFileEx at the same high offset the Python shim uses); link targets in tests must be fixture siblings, never system or TEMP directories.
test_output.c's BSD-socket fake HTTP server is rewritten with GSocketListener on loopback. test_data_client.c binds loopback instead of any-inet-port to avoid Windows Firewall prompts.

On Windows, CTest ENVIRONMENT drops GDK_BACKEND=x11, sets GDK_SCALE=1, sets RADIOS_AUDIO_BACKEND=none for GUI tests without owned sinks, and replaces WORKING_DIRECTORY /tmp with a build directory. Tests touching the system clipboard get a RESOURCE_LOCK.
risks: Production code that relies on g_file_test(IS_SYMLINK) or g_lstat for its no-follow and confinement checks is silently insecure on Windows. If the tests' own remove_tree helpers are ported naively, they can recursively delete a link target such as %TEMP%.

Planner and media containment checks compare canonicalized paths (backslashes) with raw strings that contain forward slashes. test_playout, test_playout_event_blocks, test_automation_probability_playout and test_automation_calendar_plan reject every fixture until both the test and production code canonicalize (src/playout/planner.c:308-311).
IANA time zones are unsupported by GLib on Windows (NULL). Station-timezone header tests, the loudness and automation policies and DST cases fail until the platform tz function exists.
Posted-message input bypasses the OS input pipeline. Real OLE drag-and-drop, grabs and tooltips may still need SendInput on the interactive desktop (CI only, serialized).
Geometry and screenshot tests depend on monitor size and DPI. Windows clamps windows to the monitor (1904x1161 on 1920x1200), while the content-scale tests used Xvfb at 2560x1600.
Timing-sensitive assertions (3.3 ms seek bursts, 5 ms heartbeats, <20 ms snapshots, soak ±10%) are fragile even with timeBeginPeriod(1), which gives about 2 ms granularity.
G_DEBUG=fatal-warnings may expose Windows-only GTK/GIO warnings (selection atoms, UWP app-info scanning, icon theme) that abort tests.
Without the virtual audio backend, 50 test files cannot run their PCM entries. Real-hardware WASAPI would be non-deterministic and cannot provide multiple named sinks or monitor capture on CI.

Sharing violations from the Python service, Defender scanning or asynchronous decoder closes make unlink, rename and set_contents assertions flaky unless retried, and unless the production code opens media with FILE_SHARE_DELETE.
The subset-link targets (rotation editor and others) may need hand-maintained Windows stub lists, which can drift as the UI sources change.
Every GUI/runner test also depends on the Python runners being ported (Xvfb, dbus, pactl/parec, os.pipe/select on file descriptors, POSIX signals). Until then they all skip or fail on Windows.
test_admin_ui copies a real API token to the Windows system clipboard (production behaviour), where Clipboard History or cloud sync may keep it.
cross_area_dependencies: build: every test target links the activeCodePage=UTF-8 / per-monitor-DPI manifest and tests/support/radios_test_runtime_win32.c; on WIN32, pkg_check_modules(libpulse, alsa, xtst, x11) are no longer REQUIRED; GDK_BACKEND=x11 is removed from the 64 ENVIRONMENT entries; WORKING_DIRECTORY /tmp is replaced; ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION PATH puts ucrt64/bin first; ws2_32/winmm/psapi are linked; the D twins replace pulse_hotplug, native_midi_hotplug_* and audio_recovery; RESOURCE_LOCK system_clipboard and native_input are added.

audio: virtual WASAPI backend (RADIOS_AUDIO_BACKEND=virtual|none|wasapi; RADIOS_AUDIO_VIRTUAL_SINKS; each sink exposes <sink>.monitor; RADIOS_AUDIO_VIRTUAL_CAPTURE_DIR files are float32le stereo, written continuously from process start with silence when idle, shared FILE_SHARE_*; any requested rate; process-wide mixing; real-time pacing; device ids == names). Test-only control API: radios_audio_virtual_server_stop/restart(keep_sinks)/sink_add/sink_remove. A server-string mapping for NULL, 'none:', 'virtual:' and the legacy 'unix:/nonexistent/...'. An internal radios_wasapi_create_enumerator() seam for the fake-enumerator hotplug test. Unchanged snapshot fields: loss_epoch, consumed_frames, output_flushes, ready/error.

audio/media: the decoder and analyzer open media with FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE|FILE_SHARE_DELETE and close it synchronously on unload/close, so changed-file detection and unlink-after-unload behave as on Linux. No-follow opens reject symlinks and junctions in every path component.

midi: the WinMM backend lives in its own TU (src/core/midi_winmm.c) so a test can include it with #define-renamed midiIn* functions. Port ids are name-based and stable across hotplug. The same public API, notices and UI widget names/status texts are kept, with hotplug notification within 300 ms and polling within about 1 s.

core: radios_config_load, local_ini, preferences_storage, ui_preferences, storage_locations, media_archive, recovery and data_client implement owner-only files, no-follow and reparse checks, atomic replace without leftovers, and Windows path-syntax rules. The tests assert these.
playout/core: containment checks canonicalize both sides and compare case-insensitively on Windows (src/playout/planner.c:308-311 and similar).

ui: no GDK_IS_X11_DISPLAY dependency in src/ui/content_scale.c:483; a Windows private-font loading path for InterVariable.woff2 (fontconfig registration does not reach Pango-win32); rejection of file:// URIs with a non-local host before any filesystem access (UNC/SMB leak); optional exclusion of copied secrets from Clipboard History.
app: a Windows graceful-shutdown equivalent of g_unix_signal_add(SIGTERM/SIGINT) in src/app/main.c:55-56, used by test_application_shutdown.py together with application_shutdown_driver.c.

tests-py: Windows runners replace Xvfb/dbus/pactl/parec with the private-desktop launcher and the virtual audio env, keep argv/cwd/env/gate-file names, use Path.stem for test_audio_ui.exe (run_audio_ui.py:221), poll gate files with stat only, and use the service stop/start that test_data_ui.c:626-636 spawns.
python-sdbase shim: LockFileEx byte offset and range shared with radios_platform_lock_fd; private key and credential files created owner-only; gate-file reads release their handles immediately.
platform_api_needs: gboolean radios_platform_replace_file(const gchar *path, const void *data, gsize length, gboolean owner_only, GError **error) — temp file in the same directory, write, FlushFileBuffers, MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH); retries ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION/ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED/ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION for up to about 2 s; leaves no temp or backup file behind; owner_only applies a protected owner-only DACL. POSIX: write+fsync+rename+dir fsync.
gint radios_platform_unlink(const gchar *path) — g_unlink with a retry of up to 2 s on EACCES/EBUSY (sharing violation or delete pending); returns 0 or -1 with errno set.

gboolean radios_platform_path_is_private(const gchar *path, GError **error) — POSIX: regular file, (st_mode & 077)==0, owner == euid. Windows: the owner is the current user SID, the DACL is protected (no inherited ACEs), and access is granted only to the current user (optionally SYSTEM/Administrators); no Everyone/Users/Authenticated Users ACE.
gboolean radios_platform_make_private(const gchar *path, GError **error) — chmod 0600 / SetNamedSecurityInfoW with a protected owner-only DACL.
gboolean radios_platform_is_link(const gchar *path) — never follows. POSIX lstat S_ISLNK; Windows GetFileAttributesW & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT, covering symlinks and junctions/mount points.

gchar *radios_platform_real_path(const gchar *path, GError **error) — POSIX realpath; Windows CreateFileW(FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS) + GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED|VOLUME_NAME_DOS) with \\?\ and \\?\UNC\ stripped; returns long (non-8.3) UTF-8 names.

gboolean radios_platform_file_identity(const gchar *path_or_null, gint fd, RadioSFileIdentity *out) — POSIX (st_dev, st_ino, size, mtime ns); Windows VolumeSerialNumber + 128-bit FileId (GetFileInformationByHandleEx FileIdInfo, falling back to nFileIndexHigh/Low) + size + LastWriteTime at 100 ns.

gint radios_platform_lock_fd(gint fd, guint flags) — flags RADIOS_LOCK_SH|RADIOS_LOCK_EX|RADIOS_LOCK_NB|RADIOS_LOCK_UN with BSD flock semantics. Windows: LockFileEx/UnlockFileEx on _get_osfhandle(fd), 1 byte at a shared high offset (same constant as the Python shim); a conversion is unlock then lock; returns -1 with errno EWOULDBLOCK when non-blocking and busy; the lock is released on close or process exit.
gint64 radios_platform_disk_free(const gchar *path) / gint64 radios_platform_disk_total(const gchar *path) — statvfs / GetDiskFreeSpaceExW; -1 for a missing path.
gboolean radios_platform_path_equal(const gchar *a, const gchar *b) — canonicalize both, unify separators, case-insensitive on Windows.

GTimeZone *radios_platform_time_zone_new(const gchar *iana_id) — IANA identifiers on Windows (bundled tzdata TZif parsing, or IANA→Windows-zone mapping fed to g_time_zone_new_identifier); NULL for invalid ids such as 'Not/AZone' or 'Europe/../UTC'; on POSIX this wraps g_time_zone_new_identifier.
gboolean radios_platform_time_zone_valid(const gchar *iana_id) — validation used by the loudness, automation and header code paths, replacing src/core/loudness_policy.c's /usr/share/zoneinfo lookup.

void radios_platform_timer_resolution_begin(void) / void radios_platform_timer_resolution_end(void) — timeBeginPeriod(1)/timeEndPeriod(1) on Windows, no-op on POSIX (the test runtime TU calls it unconditionally).

Test-only (tests/radios_test_support.c, not platform.h): rt_symlink (CreateSymbolicLinkW with ALLOW_UNPRIVILEGED_CREATE, then a junction for directories, else G_IO_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED), rt_create_sized_file (FSCTL_SET_SPARSE + SetEndOfFile), rt_pread/rt_pwrite (ReadFile/WriteFile with OVERLAPPED offset), rt_make_world_readable (Everyone:R ACE), rt_process_resident_bytes (GetProcessMemoryInfo), rt_process_handle_count (GetProcessHandleCount), rt_numeric_locale_push/pop (_configthreadlocale + setlocale), rt_selection_data_new (GDK_SELECTION_PRIMARY), rt_input_motion/button/key/pointer (PostMessageW to the GDK HWND or SendInput).
